q: By what nickname are Swansea City known?
hint: The swan appears on the club badge, and supporters are also known as the Jack Army.

q: In 2011 Swansea City became the first Welsh club to do what?
hint: They won the Championship play-off final at Wembley to go up, and stayed in the top flight for seven seasons.

q: Swansea City won the League Cup in 2013, beating which club in the final?
hint: They won 5-0 against a League Two side, the biggest winning margin in the final's history.

q: Swansea City's rivalry, the South Wales derby, is with which club?
hint: The two clubs are around 40 miles apart, and the fixture carries heavy policing and long-standing hostility.

q: Which ground did Swansea City leave in 2005 after 93 years?
hint: The name came from the vegetable crop grown on the land before the club moved in.

q: Which manager led Swansea City into the Premier League in 2011?
hint: Rodgers left for Liverpool the following summer, and Laudrup replaced him and won the League Cup.

q: Which Danish former Barcelona and Real Madrid player managed Swansea City to the 2013 League Cup?
hint: Laudrup's side beat Bradford City 5-0, delivering Swansea's first major English trophy.

q: Which Spanish striker, signed for a small fee in 2012, scored 22 goals in his first Swansea City season?
hint: Michu arrived from Rayo Vallecano for around £2 million and became one of the buys of the decade.

q: Which Welsh former Liverpool striker managed Swansea City to four promotions from 1978?
hint: Toshack took them from the Fourth Division to the First in four seasons as player-manager.

q: What colours do Swansea City wear at home?
hint: The all-white kit is the reason for the nickname's association with the swan.

q: Like Cardiff and Wrexham, Swansea City are a Welsh club competing in which league system?
hint: Welsh clubs joined the English pyramid long before a national Welsh league existed.

q: What is the name of Swansea City's home ground, opened in 2005?
hint: It was known as the Liberty Stadium for most of its existence before a naming-rights change.

q: Swansea City's supporters' trust is notable for what?
o: Holding a stake in the club through its rise
hint: The trust took a shareholding when the club was near liquidation in 2002 and retained it through the Premier League years.

q: Which Ivorian striker did Swansea City sell to Manchester City in 2015 after a prolific spell?
hint: Bony had been the Premier League's leading scorer across the previous calendar year.

q: Which Spaniard managed Swansea City from 2007, later winning the FA Cup with Wigan?
hint: Martínez had played for Swansea before managing them, and established the passing style Rodgers inherited.

q: Swansea City were founded in which year?
hint: They were formed as Swansea Town and adopted the City name in 1969, when Swansea was granted city status.
